title: NeoRadar runwayPreferences document
description: The vAcc's runway preferences: what the server picks at an airport where no controller and no published layer names a runway on either side. Authored as runwayPreferences.json beside the package's config.json; `neoradar-cli convert` checks it against this schema and carries it in server-dataset.json under `runwayPreferences`. No file, an airport not listed, or no configuration that holds means the server picks from the wind alone. An airport's configurations are tried in order and the first whose `when` holds and whose runway set in force names no runway excluded at that instant wins; an absent `when` always holds. An excluded runway is never picked by the wind either. The server refuses a document whole, naming the key. Not expressible here and checked by the server: a configuration name repeated within one airport; a timezone that is not a loadable IANA zone; a localTime whose `from` equals its `to`; an epoch or a `dates` end that is not a real calendar date; a `dates` range whose `from` is not before its `to`; a `$name` naming no condition of its airport, or a named condition referring back to itself; a wind limit under an exclusion's `unless`, directly or through a `$name`; an exclusion with no `unless` of a runway that a fixed configuration, or every phase of an alternation, names.

$schema.description: Editor hint only. `neoradar-cli convert` drops it, because the server refuses unknown keys.

vacc.description: The vAcc this document is for: the package manifest namespace, any case. The server and the convert refuse any other.

airports.description: Preferences per airport, keyed by 4-letter upper-case ICAO code.

airport.description: One airport's configurations, tried in order, and the runways it keeps out of every pick. It names configurations, exclusions or both: an airport with exclusions alone is picked from the wind, never on an excluded runway.

timezone.description: The airport's IANA time zone (Europe/London), which every localTime, days and changeAt is read in.

description.description: Free text for the author: the sources quoted, and after `To add when known:` what the sources do not give.

conditions.description: Named conditions of this airport, each written once and used as "$name" in any condition of the airport, another named one included. A name is a lower-case letter then up to 23 letters or digits.

exclude.description: Runways kept out of every pick, configurations and the wind pick alike, checked at each pick.

configurations.description: The airport's configurations in order of preference.

configuration.description: One runway configuration. A fixed one names its runway set in `runways`; an alternating one names a cycle of runway sets in `alternation`. Each refuses the other's block. It holds when its `when`, one condition, holds (an absent `when` always holds) and its runway set in force names no runway excluded at that instant.

name.description: The name the wire and the client show, unique within its airport. 1 to 24 characters.

mode.description: `fixed`: the runway set in `runways` always. `alternates`: the runway set of the phase of `alternation` in effect.

runwaySet.description: The runways in use, at least one on either side. A side left empty is no runways there.

arrival.description: Arrival runways, by designator, the preferred first.

designator.description: A runway designator: 01 to 36, then L, C or R where the airport has parallels (27L, 09, 18C).

alternation.description: A cycle of runway sets. The phase in effect is floor(civil days from epoch to the cycle date / periodDays) mod the number of phases, counting back before the epoch; the cycle date is the local date, or the day before when the local time is before changeAt.

periodDays.description: How long each phase lasts. Unit: civil days.

epoch.description: The local date the first phase starts, YYYY-MM-DD.

changeAt.description: The local time a phase turns, HH:MM. Default 00:00.

phases.description: The runway sets in cycle order, from the epoch.

exclusion.description: Runways kept out of every pick while `unless` does not hold; with no `unless`, always. A configuration whose runway set in force names one does not hold and the next is tried; the wind pick never considers one. With no METAR an `unless` reads the weather as a `when` does, so one that needs bad weather does not hold; a wind limit may not appear under it.

runways.description: The runways kept out, by designator: each end named, as a configuration names it.

condition.description: A condition: an object whose keys all hold; "$name", a named condition of this airport; or ["AND", [...]], ["OR", [...]] or ["NOT", [...]] over a list of conditions, where NOT holds when none of them holds.

conditionName.description: A named condition of this airport, from its `conditions`: "$night".

combination.description: An operator and one list of conditions: AND holds when every one holds, OR when any one holds, NOT when none holds.

dateRange.description: A range of local instants in the airport's zone. `from` is inclusive, a date alone meaning its 00:00; a `to` with a time is exclusive, a date alone takes in that whole day.

localDateOrMinute.description: A local date, YYYY-MM-DD, or a local date and time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

leaf.description: Conditions, all of which must hold. Wind limits apply to every runway of the runway set in effect, departure and arrival, and hold when there is no METAR; visibility, ceiling and RVR limits fail when there is none.

maxTailwind.description: Holds when every runway's tailwind, from the gust when reported, is at or below it. Unit: kt.

maxCrosswind.description: Holds when every runway's crosswind, from the gust when reported, is at or below it. Unit: kt.

minHeadwind.description: Holds when every runway's headwind, from the mean speed (a gust never helps), is at or above it. Unit: kt.

maxVisibility.description: Holds when the prevailing visibility is at or below it. Unit: m.

maxCeiling.description: Holds when a ceiling exists at or below it. Unit: ft.

maxRvr.description: Holds when the METAR's runway visual range for `runway` is at or below `limit`: a range reported as varying reads its lower value, one above the instrument's top never holds, one below its foot holds for any limit at or above that foot. No RVR reported for the runway fails it.

localTime.description: Holds when the airport's local time is in [from, to); wraps midnight when `to` is before `from`.

days.description: Holds when the local weekday of the instant is listed.

dates.description: Holds when the local instant falls in any of these ranges. Ranges are absolute: one notified by NOTAM is written with its dates, and a range wholly past never holds.
